name: Senior Agent Skills
summary: Ten SKILL.md playbooks that make coding agents work like senior engineers: recon, planning, TDD, debugging, refactor, review, git hygiene.
description: Ten portable Agent Skills playbooks for the engineering loop: repo-recon (map before you touch), plan-first, tdd-loop (red before green), debug-protocol (reproduce first), evaluate-ai-changes, safe-refactor, dead-code-audit, self-review, verify-done (evidence or it didn't happen) and git-hygiene. Each is a plain SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter — no scripts or dependencies — installed with one command into Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity, OpenCode, Copilot and Cursor or the ~/.agents/skills/ interop path; an AGENTS.md index covers hosts that only read AGENTS.md.
contains: 10 skills: repo-recon, plan-first, tdd-loop, debug-protocol, evaluate-ai-changes
plus safe-refactor, dead-code-audit, self-review, verify-done, git-hygiene
one-command installer: bash install.sh or install.ps1, with copy and project modes
targets Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity, OpenCode, Copilot, Cursor and the ~/.agents/skills/ interop path
plain markdown: SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter, no scripts or dependencies
eval tooling: runbook, cases/ and rubric for fresh-session forward tests
AGENTS.md drop-in index for harnesses that only read AGENTS.md
tuning: edit the description frontmatter to fix triggering; house rules live in the skill bodies
